leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi J.R.,

I'm Roland Jacobs, a designer and book services specialist who helps authors present, publish and promote their books professionally.

I came across Omega Rose while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Inga Adamsen's home genetics test being quietly flagged by an unseen system, and in her fellowship at Lyndhurst Biotech Labs.

Those details gave me an idea for how a book-focused refresh of your website could help present your book to more of the readers who may enjoy it. I'd build each book a clear page that leads with Inga Adamsen's home genetics test being quietly flagged by an unseen system, with buy links and a sign-up right beside it.

I'd be glad to sketch a complimentary concept sample, no obligation.

Would you like to see it?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
